note: Differential against math/big over 48 methods, but also compares panics, the receiver's and operands' final values under every aliasing pattern (z==x, z==y, x==y), and round-trips through big.Int; unusually thorough for a differential test.
Aliasing independence (c.Ceil(x, x) == c.Ceil(&d, x)), a property shape rarely tested, and it exposed a high-severity wrong result.
drives the picker over a real random directory tree (hidden files, symlinks to files/dirs/nowhere) built in a temp dir per case, mirroring listing, window and DidSelect reports

parses ViewAs into runes with their SGR fg/bg and checks every cell's colour against a blend/colour-function model; options applied in random order; surfaced an upstream lipgloss colour spike (lipgloss/28)
drives a physical spring animation (random frequency/damping) to equilibrium and asserts convergence to within 0.001 with settled velocity; also clamping and stale/foreign frames ignored

runs tea.Cmds synchronously and mirrors the tick chains in flight (tag/timeout flag per pending tick, delivered in rounds, stale/foreign/ID-0 ticks injected) -- a model of the async message queue, not just the component

random frames on a Screen; the emitted terminal bytes are replayed into a terminal emulator (charmbracelet/x/vt, a separate module of the same monorepo) whose cells must equal the Screen's buffer - an emulator as oracle for a screen-diff optimiser
one-sided differential: klauspost may never be more lenient than the reference zstd on a corrupted frame, while the reference's own documented leniencies are deliberately not compared
single fixed input run in a child process because a Go stack overflow is fatal and cannot be recovered in-process
metamorphic relation: excluding runes equals substituting private-use placeholder runes and mapping back, for words, error and Position
pins go-units/5; asserts error-message quality (the message must name the offending argument), not a value
injects a scripted clock, random stream and hardware address so every bit of 1-6 successive UUIDs (clock-sequence and v7 counter stepping included) is predicted from the RFC layouts

Grammar-generated jq programs (~80 builtins, paths, reduce/foreach, regex, time, assignment) run against the reference jq 1.8.2 binary, outputs compared as canonical trees with ulp tolerance and matching error kinds.

A full cell-grid model of Style.Render (padding, margins, borders, alignment, wrapping, pens, hyperlinks) compared against the ANSI output parsed back into cells; several known bugs are counted rather than failed.
a round trip through external tools: bash, dash and busybox ash read the quoted text back as the original words
a fake TTY answers OSC 10/11 queries with generated X11 rgb: replies; the expected colour is known by construction, with the documented COLORFGBG fallback
glibc strftime reached through Python ctypes in a long-lived child process, struct tm with tm_gmtoff so %z/%Z see fixed zones

random frame sequences through TerminalRenderer into the charmbracelet/x/vt terminal emulator; the emulator screen, the renderer record and its cursor model must all equal the frame; found uv/24 (7% of frames) and uv/25 (1 in 20000)

API-ergonomics property: a decoded key must MatchString its own Keystroke()/String(), i.e. a binding written from what the program prints must fire; print/match pair treated as format/parse; gated six bugs (uv/4-7,14,15)
differential against ratatui, the Rust original the Go layout package is a translation of, run as a cargo-built child process over one layout per line

oracle is a Python UAX #29 reference written by the harness from the annex and validated against the UCD break-test files before use; written for the test so model-oracle rather than external, although it runs out of process

a test-written YAML 1.2 emitter with random syntax choices renders a tree; v4 must load it to that tree (expected known by construction); yaml.v3 arbitrates so a disagreement is a test-suite defect, not a v4 bug
APT itself (apt-get update --print-uris on a temporary offline config) is the oracle for the set of index targets a sources file yields
reverse round trip on near-DER garbage: whatever parses must re-serialize to exactly the input bytes (DER canonicity), ported from the crate's fuzz target
exhaustive position x charset sweep asserting the BCH checksum's single-substitution detection guarantee, with a liveness bound on probes
compares /= with / under catch_unwind for every divisor including zero: same value or both panic; that is how bigdecimal/2 (d /= 0 silently zeroes while d / 0 panics) surfaced
tests exact tightness of a runtime-limit knob with boundary-boosted generation (limit +/- 1); found an off-by-one (boa/1)
injectivity of the encoder (x != y => enc(x) != enc(y)), with single-field mutations generated to hunt near-collisions
documented nesting limit is a tight bound; drawn depths up to 20,000 so an unenforced limit would abort the process rather than fail an assertion
Beyond the error itself it asserts a resource bound: a claimed huge length must not be pre-allocated and must fail quickly
Also asserts storage class (an f64 is always inline, short results inlined), a property about allocation rather than text
Oracle is Python's configparser in a child process, configured to the crate's defaults, with the generator restricted to the intersection of the two grammars

Uses a permissive twin encoding (check_trailing_bits=false) as a detector of same-data spellings, asserts the strict encoding rejects each with Trailing at the last position, and checks the count of such spellings is exactly 2^t - 1 (a counting model of base-N malleability).
oracle is dpkg's Dpkg::Deps evaluation against a generated KnownFacts of installed packages, i.e. dpkg's real dependency resolver

crate compared to an in-test find_files model; python-debian validates the model only for single-pattern paragraphs because its globs_to_re anchors only the last alternative -- a test that works around a known bug in its oracle
oracle is devscripts' own Perl safe_replace driven as a persistent child, so Perl regex/replacement semantics are tested directly; regex-dialect nuances are excluded explicitly
uses `git check-ref-format refs/tags/<tag>` as the oracle for DEP-14 tag mangling
time travel: every historical version is checked out and compared with the model's snapshot at that step
a termination/resource-bound property: constructed catastrophic patterns must hit the documented backtrack limit and return BacktrackLimitExceeded rather than hang
drives CPython's format() as a subprocess differential oracle, emulating the crate's documented deviations on the Python side
involution: rename -> print -> reparse -> rename must restore the source byte-for-byte, a clever way to check trivia preservation through a mutating visitor
uses the ellipsoid's reflection symmetries (equator, meridian) as isometry metamorphic relations on geodesic distance
a resource-bound contract: a crafted tiny file declaring a huge frame must be refused under the memory limit rather than allocated
an allocation property: asserts the output Vec's capacity stays within a factor of the configured memory limit; fully fixed inputs (narrowed pin)
oracle mixes f64 parse plus test rounding with crafted exact decimal expansions of midpoints (tie / just-above / just-below), a clever adversarial input construction
accept-iff-canonical: a mutated text may be accepted only if it is exactly the canonical rendering (per jiff) of what it parsed to; strictness checked without a grammar model

oracle is the inverse: the printed text is parsed back and must be well-formed per the documented structure and within half a unit of the last printed decimal of the input, avoiding a re-implementation of the formatter
Checks error-report quality rather than acceptance: reported offsets are in-bounds char boundaries and the UnknownUnit span must reproduce the unit verbatim.
Exact winding-number oracle on the inputs, sampled only at points farther than a guard band from every input segment so the library's integer snapping of intersections cannot flip the classification.
260 queries alternating between two indices deliberately drive the Visited u8 generation counter through its wraparound while comparing a reused Search handle with a fresh one.
Metamorphic relation aimed at the u128 printer's 10^16 block split: text(hi*10^16+lo) == text(hi) ++ lo zero-padded to 16 digits; plus widening invariance across integer types.
besides no-abort it caps the event count at O(depth) with tc.target on depth, turning a hang/OOM from superlinear emission into a falsifiable failure; the depth cap gates around jotdown/1
cross-numeric-type oracle: a FixedI32 tree is checked against f64 brute force on a 1/256 lattice representable exactly in both
uses the convex-hull bounds (chord length <= arc length <= control-polygon length) as a cheap mathematical oracle for a numerical arc-length routine; gates around kurbo/4
checks error-report quality rather than acceptance: message text per kind, Display/alternate layout, and that the tilde/caret indicator has exactly one caret per byte of the erroneous span
the oracle is lintian itself: Lintian::Processable::Overrides::parse_overrides run in a persistent Perl child against a fake processable

CRDT strong-eventual-consistency: replicas edited concurrently with random partial syncs mid-stream (drawn direction and encoding) and a random full-mesh exchange order must be deep-equal; order-independence of merge
A*A^-1 = I with a tolerance derived from LU backward-stability theory that self-scales with the measured condition number kappa_F, rather than a fixed epsilon
two-sided panic-as-specification: every operator and Float function must equal the primitive bit for bit, or panic exactly when the primitive result is non-finite/NaN, checked with catch_unwind
independence from the internal Ascii/Unicode string representation; this shape surfaced two representation-specific bugs (nucleo/4, nucleo/6)
Unicode numerals: parse must either reject or yield exactly the value the decimal digits denote (expected known by construction); an unusual input class that found a real misparse
statelessness of a reused buffer-based formatter across a random call sequence and three entry points; found the high-severity prefix-overwrite crash numfmt/1
wrapper ops compared to the primitive float ops (stdlib) with panic-iff-NaN checked via catch_unwind: panicking is itself a specified, tested outcome
differential against GNU patch(1) down to the per-hunk (offset, fuzz) outcome and the partial output after failures
date(1) as the oracle for timestamp formatting at an offset
the oracle is also used to build a perfect consistent heuristic (exact distance-to-goal on the reversed graph) to exercise A*'s non-trivial path
also checks the documented allocation behaviour: Cow must be Borrowed when nothing decodes
A performance property: asserts a linear event-count bound and a wall-clock bound, and uses tc.target(elapsed) to steer generation toward slow inputs (DoS hunting).
Same targeted-search performance shape as deeply_nested_input_parses_in_bounded_time, for constructs nesting across lines.
Same targeted-search performance shape; repeats short adversarial patterns (the dos-fuzzer axis) and asserts linear event count and bounded time.
end-to-end write/read through a full simulated QUIC connection with random MTU, latency and interleaved link driving; the whole protocol stack is the operation
models the trie's internal node layout (root, stored keys and all pairwise nibble LCPs) to predict which node a raw ancestor query lands on, not just the map semantics
resource-limit property: any positive max_operations must terminate an infinite loop with ErrorTooManyOperations (termination/limit enforcement, not functional output)
cross-predicate metamorphic relation: embed 2D points at z=0 with an apex so det3 = h*det2 exactly, so orient3d and orient2d signs must agree
witness construction: integer lattice points on the radius-65 circle (Pythagorean) so cocircularity is exact in floating point at any power-of-two scale
generated billion-laughs entity bomb must be rejected rather than expanded; a resource-exhaustion property
shift theorem as a metamorphic relation: circular shift of the input equals a per-bin phase rotation of the spectrum
derived property: within the plain-decimal layout the printed text orders like the numbers, a consequence of shortest digits plus fixed layout
std format! on the plain &str rendering is the oracle for the crate's hand-written width/fill/alignment padding
join/quote output split back by bash, dash, busybox ash, Python shlex and the crate itself; four independent external oracles for one round trip
two databases reaching the same contents by different histories (junk keys inserted and removed, reverse order, overwrites) must have equal checksum
Euler's formula V - E + F = 2 as the invariant after a random insert/remove sequence, with the documented collinear special case
eq/hash consistency observed indirectly through dict key collapse (len(d)==1 iff x==y) across mixed numeric types, rather than by calling hash directly

pdf checked against a central finite difference of the library's own cdf/sf, with the step and tolerance derived from tail mass and the crate's accuracy target; a calculus relation between two library functions rather than an external oracle

'wire-shaped garbage' generator: valid sfnt header plus a generated table directory of real/random tags and offsets, to get past the is_font gate and reach table parsers with plausible-but-arbitrary content

generates a random complete prefix code by repeatedly splitting leaves, then round-trips symbol sequences through the codebook decoder in both bit orders and every bits-per-read setting; the configuration is generated too
cache-consistency metamorphic check: mutate a laid-out tree, recompute incrementally, and compare bit-for-bit with a fresh tree of the same final structure; found taffy/1

Path-traversal safety checked on the real filesystem: raw header names with .. bypass the writer's validation, and a canary in a three-level-deep tempdir shows nothing lands outside dst. Assertion is skipped-or-Err, so rejection is the runner-up.

The decoder is checked against a spec-transcribed TIFF writer written in the test, independent of the crate's own encoder, in both byte orders; this sidesteps the shared-bug blind spot of encoder/decoder round trips. Expected samples are the source pixels.

29 format-description components mapped onto strftime specifiers and compared with jiff character for character, singly and in drawn combinations with drawn separators; the combined text is also parsed back by both libraries.

Edit locality: the generator keeps the document as segments so the expected output after a single value edit is rebuilt byte-for-byte (only the edited line changes, key decor kept, value decor reset), a precise format-preservation property rather than a mere round trip.

Normalization distributes over concatenation when the second piece starts at a stable code point (ccc 0 and quick-check Yes), the UAX #15 concatenation guarantee turned into a metamorphic relation across all four forms.
differential acceptance on single-character mutants of valid filenames, with a documented-leniency allowlist for each direction of disagreement
negate/and/or checked as boolean connectives by sampling environments; is_true/is_false/is_disjoint soundness checked the same way; idempotence, double negation and De Morgan on canonical trees
oracle is pip's private req_file parser run over a generated on-disk tree of requirements files with includes, continuations and env-var expansion, folded the way uv flattens
the solver's emitted UNSAT proof is validated by the crate's standalone proof checker: a certificate-checking oracle rather than a value comparison
a resource-accounting property: fuel consumed is independent of the budget, and exactly the consumed amount (extra == 0) is sufficient
besides Err, the test relies on an OOM abort to detect attacker-controlled preallocation from a crafted DER length header: an allocation-behaviour property
asserts pointer provenance (every zero-copy slice lies inside the input allocation) rather than any parsed value
a probabilistic property: distinct seeds must give distinct hashes, justified by the ~2^-64 collision odds rather than by any specification
same probabilistic seed-mixing property as the xxh64 variant, for both 64- and 128-bit digests
quote() output is actually executed by dash and bash (printf '%s\0' with globbing off, empty cwd) and must read back as the given argv, plus parse() as a third reader
